targets.rawSql: WITH latest_alive AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (asset_id) asset_id, value, ts FROM metrics WHERE metric = 'host.alive' ORDER BY asset_id, ts DESC), latest_rtt AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (asset_id) asset_id, value, ts FROM metrics WHERE metric = 'icmp.rtt_ms' ORDER BY asset_id, ts DESC), latest_loss AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (asset_id) asset_id, value, ts FROM metrics WHERE metric = 'icmp.loss_pct' ORDER BY asset_id, ts DESC), latest_loop AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (asset_id) asset_id, score, ts FROM anomaly_scores WHERE metric = 'loop_risk' ORDER BY asset_id, ts DESC), open_incidents AS (SELECT asset_id, count(*) AS open_incidents FROM incidents WHERE lower(status) = 'open' GROUP BY asset_id) SELECT a.name AS "Host", COALESCE(g.path, 'Sem grupo') AS "Grupo", COALESCE(t.name, 'Sem template') AS "Template", CASE WHEN NOT a.enabled THEN 'Inativo' WHEN la.value IS NULL THEN 'Sem telemetria' WHEN la.value < 1 THEN 'Indisponivel' ELSE 'Saudavel' END AS "Saude", COALESCE(oi.open_incidents, 0) AS "Incidentes abertos", ROUND(COALESCE(ll.score, 0)::numeric * 100, 0) AS "Loop risk (%)", ROUND(lr.value::numeric, 2) AS "RTT (ms)", ROUND(lx.value::numeric, 2) AS "Perda (%)", COALESCE(ll.ts, lr.ts, lx.ts, la.ts) AS "Ultima atividade" FROM assets a LEFT JOIN host_groups g ON g.id = a.group_id LEFT JOIN monitoring_templates t ON t.id = a.template_id LEFT JOIN latest_alive la ON la.asset_id = a.id LEFT JOIN latest_rtt lr ON lr.asset_id = a.id LEFT JOIN latest_loss lx ON lx.asset_id = a.id LEFT JOIN latest_loop ll ON ll.asset_id = a.id LEFT JOIN open_incidents oi ON oi.asset_id = a.id WHERE (${group_id} = -1 OR COALESCE(a.group_id, -1) = ${group_id}) AND (${template_id} = -1 OR COALESCE(a.template_id, -1) = ${template_id}) ORDER BY COALESCE(oi.open_incidents, 0) DESC, COALESCE(ll.score, 0) DESC, a.name

SELECT m.ts AS "time", a.name AS metric, m.value FROM metrics m JOIN assets a ON a.id = m.asset_id WHERE $__timeFilter(m.ts) AND m.metric = 'icmp.rtt_ms' AND (${group_id} = -1 OR COALESCE(a.group_id, -1) = ${group_id}) AND (${template_id} = -1 OR COALESCE(a.template_id, -1) = ${template_id}) ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT INITCAP(COALESCE(i.severity, 'info')) AS "Severidade", COUNT(*) AS "Abertos", MAX(COALESCE(i.last_seen_at, i.opened_at)) AS "Ultima ocorrencia" FROM incidents i LEFT JOIN assets a ON a.id = i.asset_id WHERE LOWER(i.status) = 'open' AND (${group_id} = -1 OR COALESCE(a.group_id, -1) = ${group_id}) AND (${template_id} = -1 OR COALESCE(a.template_id, -1) = ${template_id}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1

SELECT a.name AS "Host", COALESCE(g.path, 'Sem grupo') AS "Grupo", ROUND(s.score::numeric * 100, 0) AS "Score (%)", s.ts AS "Ultimo score" FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (asset_id) asset_id, score, ts FROM anomaly_scores WHERE metric = 'loop_risk' ORDER BY asset_id, ts DESC) s JOIN assets a ON a.id = s.asset_id LEFT JOIN host_groups g ON g.id = a.group_id WHERE (${group_id} = -1 OR COALESCE(a.group_id, -1) = ${group_id}) AND (${template_id} = -1 OR COALESCE(a.template_id, -1) = ${template_id}) AND s.score >= 0.20 ORDER BY s.score DESC, s.ts DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT * FROM (SELECT s.ts AS "Hora", 'Syslog' AS "Fonte", COALESCE(a.name, s.hostname) AS "Host", COALESCE(g.path, 'Sem grupo') AS "Grupo", COALESCE(s.subsystem, 'syslog') AS "Tipo", COALESCE(s.severity, 'info') AS "Severidade", s.message AS "Mensagem" FROM syslog_events s LEFT JOIN assets a ON a.id = s.asset_id LEFT JOIN host_groups g ON g.id = a.group_id WHERE $__timeFilter(s.ts) AND (${group_id} = -1 OR COALESCE(a.group_id, -1) = ${group_id}) AND (${template_id} = -1 OR COALESCE(a.template_id, -1) = ${template_id}) UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(i.last_seen_at, i.opened_at) AS "Hora", 'Incidente' AS "Fonte", COALESCE(a.name, i.hostname) AS "Host", COALESCE(g.path, 'Sem grupo') AS "Grupo", i.incident_type AS "Tipo", i.severity AS "Severidade", i.title AS "Mensagem" FROM incidents i LEFT JOIN assets a ON a.id = i.asset_id LEFT JOIN host_groups g ON g.id = a.group_id WHERE $__timeFilter(COALESCE(i.last_seen_at, i.opened_at)) AND (${group_id} = -1 OR COALESCE(a.group_id, -1) = ${group_id}) AND (${template_id} = -1 OR COALESCE(a.template_id, -1) = ${template_id})) recent ORDER BY "Hora" DESC LIMIT 25
